fieldValues.title: A definition cannot move to the package that should own it
fieldValues.statement: As our packages grow, I need to move a definition into the package it belongs in, keeping its id, so the records that use it stay valid and a published package carries what its users need. Today a definition can only be created in a package, never moved: the same definition in two packages fails validation as a duplicate id, the CLI cannot re-home it, and hand-editing package files is ruled out. So the muDemocracy `uses` relation type stays in an unpublished package, a fresh site cannot point a menu item at a page, and splitting or refining a package means making a second definition with a new id that means the same thing.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-11-11: vignette 'Refine packages safely' (srs-programme, conversation 2026-11-08 · The muDemocracy site editor on srs-web)
